depiction.primary_object: closed rectangular book with a ribbon bookmark at top
modifiers: circular badge with right-pointing play triangle in bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: single outlined object with a solid badge overlay at bottom-right

readings.meaning: video course, tutorial, or online lesson
start or resume reading a book

ambiguity: At small sizes the book outline with its ribbon can look like a shipping box with packing tape or a document page with a bookmark.

reasoning: The icon combines a book with a ribbon bookmark and a play button badge, making it a clear symbol for audiobooks, video courses, or starting a reading/learning session. It fits common personal and professional tasks around listening to books and watching tutorials, though at very small sizes the book with a top ribbon can resemble a taped shipping box.
